question: Which one of the following animals was frequently seen on the seals of the Harrapan Civilisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bull.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• The Harappan seal is possibly the most distinctive artifact of the Harappan or Indus valley civilization.
 
• Made of a stone called s**teatite, seals like this one often contain animal motifs and signs from a script that remains undeciphered.**
 
• They are engraved with images of wild or domestic animals, humans, and fantastic creatures.
 
• **The bull was frequently seen on the seals of the Harrapan Civilisation.**
 
• Harappan seals and materials were found in** Sumerian, Mesopotamian Oman, Bahrain, and Iran**.
 
• Pictures of ships, and boats have also been found on seals that throw light on Harappan contacts in far-off places.
